# ROM fixtures

Place redistributable or locally generated ROM fixtures here when the ROM
harness lands.

Prefer tiny synthetic ROM images first. Larger external suites should stay out
of the default tree unless their licensing, size, and update policy are clear.

Keep phase-scoped automation targets in matching subdirectories such as
`phase2/` and `phase4/`, with README stubs reserving filenames before the
actual assets are checked in.
